translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

book.name: Nzaelwapxngr
book.title: Nzaelwapx-krbz Jiszs Mz Jon Da Kcng Tqyc-kapq-pnzng

content: Zbz obq-rmwible-moux, x mcx kc enjrl kxmatq vzom Heven. Ngrlelvz dcbz apule lrpz kx kq-ngrde, x narde ngrlelvz nrpc'. Mzte luli apule nepi, x nanycde nzapulr nctrpou kx ngc-zli nyr.
Enjrl lc malele kc skrol kxnzyr kx nzkawxpxpe. Nanycde kxrtc atuole prla x kxmc atuole mz drtc'.
X yrlqbzle kc natqde kxetu, kx apule nzkclwzkr laion kxetu. Zbz xlrlzx kc natq Heven, apule bzlrmei kxetu x ayzlu-ngrbzle natq enjrl nzwrde rlimz.
Mzli kc tqayzlu-ngrbzle natqde, sc tqoliqtipex nzryrongr natqde kcng rlimz. A' mzli lcdepwz, kzdq natq Heven rpiomle kx, “Yrlq-kapq natq kcng rlimz, bzkq yroq.”
Zbz enjrl kc nanycde tqtuo kc prla x tuo kc mz drtc', glalzle mqde kxrtc Heven.
X esalz-ngrde drtq Gct kc nzlu-krde tqyc tqyc, x tqwz-ngrde bongavz, drtc', prla, x da kznikeng amrlx ycpxmqng elr. X sc tqrpipe enjrl lcde kx, “Mzli r nzaenzlingr yrkrpxpe.
Murde mzli kc enjrl krarlimz navxutr-ngrde trpu nede, drtwr Gct kx yc-kapq kc tqpipx-pnzbzle mz profet nedeng kcng tzwztrpzng bade, sa natutrpe.”
X nide kc tqycmneom Heven, xlr-moux nate, rpimle bange kx, “Vz x rtrngztibz skrol kc tzkawxpx mz mq enjrl kc nanycde tqtuo kc prla x kzdq tqtuo mz drtc'.”
X vzbo mz enjrl kc, sc tqrlxtipebo skrol kc topwz. Rpimle bange kx, “Twz x ngq. Sa naxngibzme mz naom nilwzde nzmrlz-krde apule hane. A' mzli kc navzope-ngrde mz nelzm, nelzm kc tqrlvqkrkxpe.”
Rtrngztibo skrol kc topwz mz mqde. Sc tqngqpex, x da zpwx, nzmrlzkr nilwzde mz naonge apule hane. A' mz nibr nzlwzo-krngele, nelznge kc tqrlvqkrkxpe.
Zbz sc tzrpipe-mop bange kx, “Napipx-mouq natq Gct lcng tqycmnetr-ngrde drtc', leplz, natq x king kang kqlu.”
